name: Post-THR Full Body: Strength, Mobility & Lower Leg
description: 7-day home-based program for 3+ months post-right THR. Uses dumbbells, resistance bands, and static bike. Progressive strength training, hip mobility restoration, lower leg strengthening, ankle stability, QL work, pelvic control, and weekly ROM assessment.

morning.title: Lower Body Strength — Hip Hinge Focus
morning.subtitle: Posterior chain + lower leg loading

exercises.name: Crossed Leg Forward Hold
exercises.notes: Stretch 1/17. Cross legs, fold forward gently.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.notes: Stretch 2/17. Soles together, knees fall open. Works toward cross-legged sitting.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch — Right Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 3/17. Seated, right leg extended, fold forward from hips.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch — Left Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 4/17. Seated, left leg extended, fold forward from hips.

exercises.name: Yogi Squat
exercises.notes: Stretch 5/17. Deep squat, feet flat, elbows pressing knees. Stop before anterior pinch.

exercises.name: 90/90 Rotations
exercises.notes: Stretch 6/17. Seated 90/90, rotate between sides. Hip IR + ER. Comfortable range only.

exercises.name: Extended Puppy Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 7/17. Knees down, walk hands forward, chest toward ground. Opens shoulders + thoracic spine.

exercises.name: Lunge + Upper Body Opener — Right Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 8/17. Low lunge, right foot forward. Open arms/chest. Stretches left hip flexor.

exercises.name: Downward Dog Walks
exercises.notes: Stretch 9/17. Downward dog, alternate bending knees. Stretches calves, hamstrings, shoulders.

exercises.name: Lunge + Upper Body Opener — Left Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 10/17. Low lunge, left foot forward. Open arms/chest. Key stretch for right hip flexor tightness.

exercises.name: Cat + Cow
exercises.notes: Stretch 11/17. All fours, alternate arching and rounding. Coordinate with breathing.

exercises.name: Camel Stretch
exercises.notes: Stretch 12/17. Kneeling, lean back. CAUTION: monitor for anterior hip pinch. Back off immediately if pinching.

exercises.name: Child Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 13/17. Knees wide, sit back on heels, arms forward. Gentle hip flexion + back relaxation.

exercises.name: Left QL Child Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 14/17. Child pose — walk hands to the right to stretch left QL.

exercises.name: Right QL Child Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 15/17. Child pose — walk hands to the left to stretch right QL. Important for right QL tightness.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch — Right Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 16/17. Daily essential. Right leg forward, posterior pelvic tilt. Absolutely NO pinching in front of right hip!

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch — Left Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 17/17. Daily essential. Left leg forward, posterior pelvic tilt, lengthen right hip flexor.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Squeeze 2 sec at top. Focus on right glute firing equally to left.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Slight backward angle, toe pointing slightly down. Targets glute med.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshells
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Light band around knees. Pelvis perpendicular to floor. Glute med activation.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Anterior/posterior tilting. Pelvic awareness and motor control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance — Right Foot
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Near wall. Progress: eyes open → closed → cushion. Right ankle proprioception.

exercises.name: Banded Ankle Eversion & Inversion
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Anchor band to furniture. Eversion = peroneals. Inversion = tib posterior. Strengthens wobbly right ankle.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion — Knee to Wall
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Measure distance in cm weekly. Tight ankles feed into wobble.

exercises.name: Weighted Hip Flexion
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Standing or seated with ankle weight or resistance band. Controlled lift with tall posture, hold 1s at top. Stop before any anterior hip pinching.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge from hips, slight knee bend. Feel hamstrings and glutes. Keep dumbbells close to legs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.notes: Focus on symmetry — do not shift right. Use mirror. Stop before anterior pinch.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step-Up (Stairs or Low Box)
exercises.notes: Use a sturdy stair or low box. Right leg leads every set. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Banded Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Band around ankles. Squeeze glute med. Keep pelvis level — no hiking. Hold wall for balance.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise (DB on Knees)
exercises.notes: Sit on chair, place dumbbell on knees. Slow 2-sec hold at top. Targets soleus — key for walking endurance.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Bilateral → Single Leg)
exercises.notes: Stand on stair edge, hold wall. Full range — drop heel below step. Hold DB for added load. Targets gastrocnemius.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Raise (Wall Lean)
exercises.notes: Lean back against wall, lift toes toward shins. Slow 2-sec eccentric. Prevents foot slap during gait.

exercises.name: Static Bike
exercises.notes: Moderate resistance. Focus on even pedalling force from both legs. Gait pattern retraining.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Lie on floor, press dumbbells up. Floor limits range — safer for shoulders. Control the eccentric.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Sit on sturdy chair. Neutral grip is joint-friendly. Brace core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Control the descent, no momentum swinging.

exercises.name: DB Overhead Tricep Extension or Skull Crushers
exercises.notes: Overhead extension standing or skull crushers lying on floor.

exercises.name: Push-Ups (Standard or Incline)
exercises.notes: Incline on chair edge if needed. Rigid body line.

exercises.name: Band Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Anchor band to door handle or sturdy post. Anti-rotation — trains obliques for pelvic control. Addresses rightward squat shift.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Transverse abdominis + coordination. Keep lower back pinned flat to ground.

exercises.name: Side Plank (Both Sides)
exercises.notes: QL strengthening bilaterally. Build up duration progressively. From knees if needed, progress to full.

exercises.name: Crossed Leg Forward Hold
exercises.notes: Stretch 1/17. Cross legs, fold forward gently.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.notes: Stretch 2/17. Soles together, knees fall open. Works toward cross-legged sitting.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch — Right Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 3/17. Seated, right leg extended, fold forward from hips.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch — Left Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 4/17. Seated, left leg extended, fold forward from hips.

exercises.name: Yogi Squat
exercises.notes: Stretch 5/17. Deep squat, feet flat, elbows pressing knees. Stop before anterior pinch.

exercises.name: 90/90 Rotations
exercises.notes: Stretch 6/17. Seated 90/90, rotate between sides. Hip IR + ER. Comfortable range only.

exercises.name: Extended Puppy Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 7/17. Knees down, walk hands forward, chest toward ground. Opens shoulders + thoracic spine.

exercises.name: Lunge + Upper Body Opener — Right Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 8/17. Low lunge, right foot forward. Open arms/chest. Stretches left hip flexor.

exercises.name: Downward Dog Walks
exercises.notes: Stretch 9/17. Downward dog, alternate bending knees. Stretches calves, hamstrings, shoulders.

exercises.name: Lunge + Upper Body Opener — Left Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 10/17. Low lunge, left foot forward. Open arms/chest. Key stretch for right hip flexor tightness.

exercises.name: Cat + Cow
exercises.notes: Stretch 11/17. All fours, alternate arching and rounding. Coordinate with breathing.

exercises.name: Camel Stretch
exercises.notes: Stretch 12/17. Kneeling, lean back. CAUTION: monitor for anterior hip pinch. Back off immediately if pinching.

exercises.name: Child Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 13/17. Knees wide, sit back on heels, arms forward. Gentle hip flexion + back relaxation.

exercises.name: Left QL Child Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 14/17. Child pose — walk hands to the right to stretch left QL.

exercises.name: Right QL Child Pose
exercises.notes: Stretch 15/17. Child pose — walk hands to the left to stretch right QL. Important for right QL tightness.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch — Right Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 16/17. Daily essential. Right leg forward, posterior pelvic tilt. Absolutely NO pinching in front of right hip!

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch — Left Leg
exercises.notes: Stretch 17/17. Daily essential. Left leg forward, posterior pelvic tilt, lengthen right hip flexor.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Squeeze 2 sec at top. Focus on right glute firing equally to left.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Slight backward angle, toe pointing slightly down. Targets glute med.

exercises.name: Banded Clamshells
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Light band around knees. Pelvis perpendicular to floor. Glute med activation.

exercises.name: Supine Pelvic Tilts
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Anterior/posterior tilting. Pelvic awareness and motor control.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance — Right Foot
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Near wall. Progress: eyes open → closed → cushion. Right ankle proprioception.

exercises.name: Banded Ankle Eversion & Inversion
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Anchor band to furniture. Eversion = peroneals. Inversion = tib posterior. Strengthens wobbly right ankle.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion — Knee to Wall
exercises.notes: Daily essential. Measure distance in cm weekly. Tight ankles feed into wobble.

exercises.name: Weighted Hip Flexion

exercises.name: ROM Test: Hip Flexion (Supine Knee to Chest)
exercises.notes: Lie on back, pull knee to chest gently. Measure fist-widths between knee and chest, or use phone camera for angle. Record both sides. Compare weekly.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Hip Internal Rotation (Seated)
exercises.notes: Sit on bed edge, knees at 90°. Let lower leg swing outward (this is IR). Photo the angle or measure with a ruler from shin to vertical. Record both sides.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Hip External Rotation (Seated)
exercises.notes: Sit on bed edge, knees at 90°. Let lower leg swing inward (this is ER). Photo or measure angle. Record both sides. Key metric for cross-legged sitting goal.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Ankle Dorsiflexion (Knee to Wall)
exercises.notes: Foot facing wall, push knee forward until it touches wall. Measure distance from big toe to wall in cm. Record both sides. Track right ankle progress.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Single-Leg Balance (Timed)
exercises.targetReps: 3 attempts per leg — record best time
exercises.notes: Stand on one leg, time until loss of balance. Eyes open first. Record best of 3. Then try eyes closed. Tracks ankle stability and proprioception progress.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Single-Leg Calf Raise Max Reps
exercises.targetReps: Max reps each leg — record count
exercises.notes: Stand on one leg, do calf raises until failure. Hold wall for balance only. Record reps per side. Tracks lower leg strength recovery.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Squat Symmetry Check (Film)
exercises.targetReps: 5 slow bodyweight squats — film from front
exercises.notes: Set phone on floor filming from front. Do 5 slow squats to comfortable depth. Review for rightward shift. Compare weekly. Note depth achieved.

exercises.name: ROM Test: Pinching Score (0–10)
exercises.notes: Rate your current anterior hip pinching: 0 = none, 10 = worst. Note when it occurs (bending, walking, rest). Record weekly to track trend. Also note walking tolerance — minutes before back stiffness.

exercises.name: Casual Walk (Outdoors if Possible)
exercises.notes: Promotes circulation and joint recovery. Focus on even gait and right foot push-off.
